    Profiles Runs Settings

    Run status — edge cases

    Failure, blocked, and boundary states. "Retry" buttons are interactive.

    Run trigger failed

    AC1 edge — onboarding engine unreachable
    Hire stage: Offer accepted ⛔ Trigger failed

    The onboarding engine did not respond. The profile stays in "Offer accepted" and no Run was created — nothing to cancel or clean up.

    Run cancellation failed

    AC2/AC3 edge — old Run would not cancel
    run_7241 (Engineering — Software Engineer II) ⛔ Cancel failed

    Role/department change to Product — Product Manager was saved, but the old Run could not be cancelled. The profile stays locked and the old Run stays Active until this resolves — the new Run is not started until it does.

    Edit blocked — sync in progress

    AC9 edge — action attempted mid-sync
    ⏳ Cancelling current Run and starting a new one…
    Department/role changed ⏳ Pending — restarting Run
    🔒 "Deactivate profile" and both edit buttons are disabled until this sync finishes — a second trigger/cancel can't be queued on top of one already in flight.

    Validation error — contact form

    AC4/AC5 edge — invalid input, values preserved
    Enter a complete email address, e.g. jordan.reyes@example.com
    Phone is required

    "Save changes" stays disabled until every field is valid. The name and start date the reviewer already typed are untouched — only the invalid fields are flagged.

    Deactivate blocked — Run still starting

    AC6/AC9 edge — deactivation attempted mid-trigger
    Hire stage: Offer accepted ⏳ Pending — starting Run

    Deactivation is queued behind the in-flight trigger, never raced against it — the button stays disabled until the new Run finishes starting, then deactivation can cancel it cleanly.

    Long role/department name

    Layout edge — no truncation, no overflow scroll
